assertions.description: WebTransport.prototype.getStats is a function (the connection-level stats surface, distinct from the per-stream getStats).
getStats is an own, configurable data property of WebTransport.prototype, as WebIDL operations are.
The method declares no required arguments (getStats()).
Calling getStats() on a live instance returns a Promise, not a synchronous value.
assertions.test: (()=>{if(typeof WebTransport!=='function'||typeof WebTransport.prototype.getStats!=='function')return false;const t=new WebTransport('https://127.0.0.1:44443/never');t.closed.catch(()=>{});const p=t.getStats();const ok=p instanceof Promise;p.catch(()=>{});try{t.close();}catch(e){}return ok;})()

assertions.description: A getStats() promise obtained while the session is connecting rejects with InvalidStateError once the session fails to establish (the spec's wait-then-reject step).
Calling getStats() on a session whose [[State]] is already "failed" rejects with InvalidStateError.
assertions.test: (async()=>{if(typeof WebTransport!=='function'||typeof WebTransport.prototype.getStats!=='function')return false;const t=new WebTransport('https://127.0.0.1:44443/never');t.closed.catch(()=>{});try{t.close();}catch(e){}try{await Promise.race([t.ready,new Promise((_,rej)=>setTimeout(()=>rej(new DOMException('timeout','TimeoutError')),8000))]);}catch(e){}try{await t.getStats();return false;}catch(e){return !!e&&e.name==='InvalidStateError';}})()
